description: This file contains utility functions for dependency management, parameter analysis, request parsing, and model validation within a FastAPI application. It includes mechanisms to handle dependencies, extract and validate request parameters, form data processing, and dynamic model generation.

classes.name: ParamDetails
classes.description: Data class to hold analyzed parameter details, including its type annotation, associated dependencies, and the corresponding model field.

classes.name: SolvedDependency
classes.description: Data class representing the result of dependency resolution, including resolved values, errors, background tasks, response object, and dependency cache.

methods.name: None ensure_multipart_is_installed()
methods.description: Checks if 'python-multipart' library is installed and correctly configured, raises RuntimeError if not.

methods.name: Dependant get_parameterless_sub_dependant(*, depends: params.Depends, path: str)
methods.description: Creates a Dependant object for a parameterless dependency, considering security scopes.

methods.name: Dependant get_flat_dependant( dependant: Dependant, *, skip_repeats: bool = False, visited: Optional[list[DependencyCacheKey]] = None, parent_oauth_scopes: Optional[list[str]] = None, )
methods.description: Flattens nested Dependant objects into a single level, merging their parameters and dependencies.

methods.name: list[ModelField] get_flat_params(dependant: Dependant)
methods.description: Retrieves flattened list of model fields for path, query, header, and cookie parameters from a Dependant.

methods.name: inspect.Signature get_typed_signature(call: Callable[..., Any])
methods.description: Returns the function signature with annotated parameters, evaluating string annotations with proper global context.

methods.name: Any get_typed_annotation(annotation: Any, globalns: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Resolves a possibly string annotation to its actual type, evaluating ForwardRef annotations.

methods.name: Any get_typed_return_annotation(call: Callable[..., Any])
methods.description: Extracts return annotation from a function, resolving string annotations if necessary.

methods.name: Dependant get_dependant( *, path: str, call: Callable[..., Any], name: Optional[str] = None, own_oauth_scopes: Optional[list[str]] = None, parent_oauth_scopes: Optional[list[str]] = None, use_cache: bool = True, scope: Union[Literal["function", "request"], None] = None, )
methods.description: Creates a Dependant object for a given path and callable, analyzing parameters for dependencies and scope.

methods.name: Optional[bool] add_non_field_param_to_dependency( *, param_name: str, type_annotation: Any, dependant: Dependant )
methods.description: Identifies special parameter types like Request, WebSocket, Response, etc., and assigns them to the Dependant.

methods.name: ParamDetails analyze_param( *, param_name: str, annotation: Any, value: Any, is_path_param: bool, )
methods.description: Analyzes a function parameter to determine its type, dependencies, and corresponding model field, supporting annotations and default values.

methods.name: Optional[ModelField] get_body_field( *, flat_dependant: Dependant, name: str, embed_body_fields: bool )
methods.description: Determines the body parameter representation for a dependant, creating combined models if necessary.

methods.name: tuple[dict[str,Any],list[Any]] request_params_to_args( fields: Sequence[ModelField], received_params: Union[Mapping[str, Any], QueryParams, Headers], )
methods.description: Converts received request parameters into a dictionary of argument values for FastAPI dependency injection.

methods.name: tuple[dict[str,Any],list[dict[str,Any]]] request_body_to_args( body_fields: list[ModelField], received_body: Optional[Union[dict[str, Any], FormData]], embed_body_fields: bool, )
methods.description: Converts the request body into argument values for dependencies, handling form data and validation.

methods.name: SolvedDependency solve_dependencies( *, request: Union[Request, WebSocket], dependant: Dependant, body: Optional[Union[dict[str, Any], FormData]] = None, background_tasks: Optional[StarletteBackgroundTasks] = None, response: Optional[Response] = None, dependency_overrides_provider: Optional[Any] = None, dependency_cache: Optional[dict[DependencyCacheKey, Any]] = None, async_exit_stack: AsyncExitStack, embed_body_fields: bool, )
methods.description: Resolves all dependencies for a given request and dependant, managing caching, error collection, and context stacks.

methods.name: None add_param_to_fields(*, field: ModelField, dependant: Dependant)
methods.description: Adds a ModelField to the appropriate parameter list in the Dependant based on its 'in' location (path, query, header, cookie).
